title: Second Street Lighting Approved
meeting_type: Tax Increment Financing (TIF #15) Board of Directors Meeting
summary:
*   Funding was approved for a significant tree lighting project along Second Street, totaling up to $235,200 over six years.
*   This unanimous decision was made by the Tax Increment Financing Reinvestment Zone #15 Board of Directors.
*   Before the TIF board met, the Austin Housing Finance Corporation meeting concluded with a 7-0 vote on an unspecified item.
*   The City Council meeting was then officially called back to order to commence its main agenda items.
